sourceQuote: Students in the first 2 years are trained in accordance with Business Administration as a largest category for a theoretical basis, and at the third school year they can finish their follow-up coursed in accordance with their own choice of specialties.
targetQuote: 第一2年的学生以工商管理作为最大的理论门类接受培养，在大学第三学年可根据自己的专业选择完成后续课程。
